source_revision: Shopify GraphQL Admin API 2026-10 (latest stable per shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning on 2026-11-01; 2025-10 is listed unsupported)
identity_rule: Account scope = Shop.id. Record identity = "stock:<InventoryItem gid>@<Location gid>"; provider_event_id = "<shop>|inv:<InventoryLevel numeric id>|<updatedAt>" so unchanged levels are duplicates and changed levels are new snapshots.
coverage_rule: Snapshot-only: the backfill reads all current levels once (history_kind snapshot_only); incremental reads items with updated_at >= floor; differences between snapshots never prove a movement cause.

retention.basis: Shopify API License and Terms of Use, merchant-owned data, read-only custom app; the merchant owns its order/payout data and installs the app on its own store. Raw provider payloads are stored as sanitized evidence (no customer names/emails/addresses) under the workspace retention policy.

unit.normalization: Constant unit "piece": Shopify line quantities are integer counts without a unit field.
unit.rule: connectors.normalize.shopify.v1: unit = "piece" for all Shopify quantities.

basis.normalization: Constant "shopify_named_quantity_states": named states are read as published; available is already net of unavailable states and is never reduced again.
basis.rule: connectors.normalize.shopify.v1: basis constant; see CONNECTOR-CAPABILITIES finding 1.

physical.missing_behavior: null when the state is not returned (never zero).

event_rules.rule: One snapshot per (item, location, updatedAt); supersedes earlier snapshots in projections; never a movement.

event_rules.unsupported_reason: Inventory adjustment history (reasons/ledger) is not part of the pinned query subset; a snapshot difference is not an adjustment observation.

synchronization.initial_import: BlackboxInventoryItems (first=25, nested inventoryLevels first=10 with eight named quantity states) over all items, Relay pagination; no provider count (totals unknown).
synchronization.cursor: Incremental query updated_at:>=floor on InventoryItem with 900 s overlap; page cursor = Relay endCursor; floor never advances past now.
synchronization.reconciliation: Every 24 h (bounded to 24 h after sleep/wake) a full re-read of changed items; identical levels are duplicates.
synchronization.deduplication: provider_event_id includes the level updatedAt; identical content = duplicate delivery; different content under the same updatedAt = conflict (review case).
synchronization.freshness: Poll every 900 s (300 s to 6 h, jitter 60 s). A successful empty poll advances last_successful_check_at only.

local_standalone.schedule: Poll every 900 s (300 s-6 h, jitter 60 s); reconciliation daily.
local_standalone.history_limit: No stock history: only current levels (snapshot_only).
local_standalone.authentication: Admin API access token for a merchant-installed custom app (X-Shopify-Access-Token), or the Dev Dashboard client-credentials grant (POST /admin/oauth/access_token, 24h token, refreshed one minute before expiry, no redirect URL). The token is stored encrypted on the connection (AES-256-GCM, key outside the database) and never logged.
local_standalone.recovery: Provider cursor and phase are persisted per page in import_runs.checkpoint / capability_health.*_cursor after COMMIT; a failed page never advances the checkpoint. Expired cursors restart the current phase from its floor (idempotent through the deliveries dedupe boundary). 401/403 stop polling with status reauthorization_required/degraded; 429 waits for Retry-After (fallback 1 s); 5xx retry with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts) then the run is re-queued with backoff; non-retryable failures become visible dead letters. After sleep/wake one coalesced poll per poll group plus one bounded overlap reconciliation (gap + overlap, capped at the reconcile window) is scheduled; no burst replay.
local_standalone.limitations: Snapshot-only; named states depend on location/app configuration; levels beyond 10 locations per item are flagged.
local_standalone.reason: Current levels are readable by polling; movement history is not, so the capability stays partial.

local_gateway.limitations: No gateway runtime exists in the pilot; declared and refused by the connector (LOCAL-07).
local_gateway.reason: local_gateway is deferred scope for the local pilot (delivery-profile.json); no gateway is provisioned and the capability declaration lists no methods for it.

public_server.limitations: No public callback is registered; localhost cannot receive Shopify webhooks.
public_server.reason: public_server is deferred scope for the local pilot; direct webhooks would require a public HTTPS endpoint that the pilot does not provide.

import_readiness.time_selection: InventoryLevel.updatedAt is the snapshot time; a date plan does not apply to stock (there is no stock history) and the plan window is disclosed as not applicable for this capability.
import_readiness.historical_availability: Only the current state is available (history_kind snapshot_only); no earlier levels are reconstructed.
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: All items/locations are read; related orders are not traversed from stock.
import_readiness.opening_state: The first snapshot is the opening stock as of its updatedAt; it is a fact, not a movement.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: loaded = inventory items fetched; committed = distinct (item, location) records with a new snapshot; totals unknown (no provider count) so counts and phase are shown, no percentage.
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Stock questions are ready for items with a snapshot not older than the schedule; partial for items without named states (null); free stock derivations require physical/committed/reserved/damaged/safety_stock/quality_control to be present.
import_readiness.health_rules: healthy after a complete poll within interval + jitter; degraded on missing read_inventory; stale snapshots are reported with their observed_at.
import_readiness.history_expansion: Not applicable beyond re-reading current levels; a history expansion creates no older snapshots.
import_readiness.data_handling: Only gids, SKU strings and integer quantities; no personal data.
